title: Document Structure Input
description: Input schema for the document-structure skill: add, remove or reorder chapters and sections.

operation.description: Structural change to make. Reordering edits the manifest only — directories are never renamed, because labels, uses[], feedback and QA sidecars all key on names.

chapter.description: Chapter directory name. Required for every operation except reorder-chapters.

title.description: Human-readable title, for the add-* operations.

position.description: Zero-based index to insert at. Appends when omitted.

order.description: The complete new order, for the reorder-* operations. Must be a permutation of the existing entries.
